Skills

Learn the action. Understand the timing. Make it work in a lap.

Mechanics

  • DRIFTTurn a controlled slide into charge, score and a better exit.
  • BOOSTBuild it in a bend. Spend it on an exit.
  • OVERCHARGEFill → build → catch → spend.
  • LOCKCommit to a stronger slide, then choose your exit.
  • SHIFTTwo setups. One car. Switch for what comes next.
  • FLOWA chain of useful decisions.
  • DRIFT ATTACKBuild the slide. Bank the points.

Techniques

  • SteeringSmall corrections. A settled car. Room for the next bend.
  • Braking & reversingGive the next corner the speed it needs.
  • Racing linesMake the exit easy before you arrive.
  • Advanced techniquesChoose an objective, then make the techniques serve it.
